id: Once Upon a Time in America (1984)
title: Once Upon a Time in America
tagline: Fifty years of friendship, one very long dinner.
about: Four Lower East Side street kids grow into Prohibition gangsters, and one of them betrays the rest.
cue: Bring the charlotte russe out when young Patsy sits on the stairs and eats the one he bought for Peggy.
faces: The old neighbourhood, Sunday morning. We grew up on this corner.

A supper in five memoriesOnce Upon a Time in AmericaFifty years of friendship, one very long dinner.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersDelancey knishesPotato and sweet onion in puff pastry, hot mustard.Made fresh every morning at the counter.How to make it500g potatoes, peeled30g butter1 brown onion, finely dicedsalt and white pepper, to taste2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beaten40g hot English mustardBoil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash.Cook the onion in the butter over low heat until golden, then mix into the mash with salt and white pepper.Cut each pastry sheet into 4 squares, fill, fold into parcels and brush with beaten egg.Bake at 200°C until golden and puffed.Serve with the hot mustard.Bagel crisps & schmearBagel rounds, chive cream cheese, smoked salmon.The old neighbourhood, Sunday morning.How to make it3 day-old bagels2 tbsp olive oil250g cream cheese2 tbsp chopped chives1 lemon, zested150g smoked salmonSlice the bagels into thin rounds and brush with olive oil.Bake at 180°C until crisp.Beat the cream cheese with chives and lemon zest.Serve the crisps with the schmear and smoked salmon on the side.MainsMoe's brisketSlow braised on onions, paprika and tomato gravy.Same table as always.How to make it1.5kg beef brisketsalt and pepper, to taste3 brown onions, sliced500ml beef stock2 tbsp tomato paste2 tsp sweet paprikaSeason the brisket and sear hard on all sides.Spread the onions in a roasting dish and sit the brisket on top. Pour over the stock whisked with tomato paste and paprika.Cover and braise at 150°C for 4 hours.Rest for 20 minutes, slice against the grain.Boil the juices for 10 minutes to make gravy.SweetsCharlotte russeSponge in a paper cup, vanilla cream piped tall, a cherry.Try not to eat it on the stairs.How to make it300g sponge cake300ml thickened cream100g mascarpone2 tbsp icing sugar1 tsp vanilla extract8 maraschino cherries8 paper cupsCut 8 rounds of sponge to fit the bottom of the paper cups.Whip the cream with mascarpone, icing sugar and vanilla to firm peaks.Pipe high over the sponge in a tall swirl and top each with a cherry.Chill for 30 minutes before serving.DrinksRye sourRye, lemon, sugar, egg white, a dash of bitters.Everything in china teacups in the back room.How to make it50g caster sugar50ml hot water120ml rye whiskey60ml lemon juice1 egg whitearomatic bitters, 8 drops1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.Shake the whiskey, lemon juice, 40ml of the syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds.Strain into four china teacups, dot the foam with bitters and serve straight away.
